acceptance: The first Homepage shows its list once, whole and in its final order: it waits while the Cloud session is still restoring (signed out is not yet known), then for the local projects' dates and the account's own listing and history dates, never for longer than the budget; a failed listing settles at once with the local projects. Released by the budget before a slow session turned up, it is not held again when the session does, nor on a later reload of the same account; a person signing in later holds it again for that account's whole list. Dates learned after a project is on screen wait for the next visit.

An account keeps its last list (names, place and permissions only, never descriptions) and dates, scoped to the API and the person; the kept list stands in at once for that account online but is not the real order until its own listing and dates answer; another account's list, or one that cannot be read, is never shown or used to date a project; offline nothing kept is shown. A failed history read keeps the project's last known date; a new sign-in of the same account keeps the list on screen while it lists again; a fresh list takes and drops rows and the kept list follows. Signing out removes the kept list; a session that is only restoring does not.

reason: TS can show an account's kept list when its session outlasts the wait, because the restoring session already names the person. A native session has no account identity until it is restored, so no kept list can be scoped to it then; past the budget the Homepage shows the local projects and the account's list joins once the session is known.

acceptance: Going Home from a project arrives at once, with the waiting mark standing in for the list (a held list is not an empty Homepage); the list shows once its projects' dates are read, as a new visit in their new order; a hold never outlasts the budget, and an earlier hold's budget or read never releases a later one.
